# rustinion_rum_application (Resource)

Manages a real-user-monitoring (RUM) application. Put `client_token` into the page's rum.js snippet; page views, Web Vitals and JavaScript errors then appear under RUM. Renaming keeps the token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `client_token` (String) Server-generated token for the browser snippet (`/v1/rum/<client_token>/events`). Public by design: it is visible in the page source.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
